# Toolzy llms.txt — AI/LLM discovery file
# https://devtools.rusiru.cc
# See also: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/ai.txt

Toolzy is a free, browser-based developer toolbox. All tools run entirely
client-side using the Web Crypto API and local JavaScript — no data, files,
or keys are ever uploaded to any server.

---

## JSON Formatter

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/json
Category: Data Formatting

Format, validate, minify, and explore JSON entirely in the browser.

Capabilities:
- Pretty-print with 2-space, 4-space, or tab indentation; minify
- Interactive tree view with click-to-copy JSONPath per node
- Search/filter keys and values with match highlighting
- Sort keys recursively
- Export to JSON, CSV, XML, or YAML
- JSON Schema generation and validation
- TypeScript type/interface generation from any JSON payload
- Stats: size, depth, key count
- Shareable links with JSON encoded in the URL
- File upload (.json) and 100% client-side processing

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Format this JSON with proper indentation"
- "Validate this JSON and show me the error"
- "Convert this JSON to CSV"
- "Generate a JSON schema from this payload"
- "Generate TypeScript interfaces from this JSON"
- "What is the depth of this JSON structure?"

## Encoding Hub

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/encode
Category: Encoding & Serialisation

Encode and decode text and files using Base64, URL-safe Base64,
percent-encoding, and Data URLs — entirely in the browser.

Capabilities:
- Base64 encode and decode (UTF-8 safe, handles multibyte characters)
- Base64 URL-safe encode and decode (+ → -, / → _, no padding)
- URL percent-encode and decode with four sub-modes: encodeURIComponent,
  encodeURI, form (x-www-form-urlencoded), RFC 3986 strict
- Data URL builder (text or file → data:[mime];base64,[data]) and decoder
  with inline image and text previews
- File encode: drag-and-drop any file to Base64 or Data URL
- Query-string table editor: parse, edit, and rebuild URL parameters
- Batch mode: encode or decode multiple lines at once (Text / JSON / CSV output)
- Character breakdown: Unicode code points and percent-encoded byte sequences
- Security scanner: flags XSS and SQL-injection patterns in URL inputs
- Auto-detect mode: identifies the encoding type and routes automatically
- All processing is client-side; no data is transmitted

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Encode this text to Base64"
- "Decode this Base64 string"
- "What does this percent-encoded URL decode to?"
- "Convert this image file to a data URL"
- "Parse the query parameters from this URL"
- "What is the difference between encodeURI and encodeURIComponent?"
- "Encode this string using RFC 3986"

## JWT Hub

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/jwt
Category: Authentication & Security

Decode, encode, and verify JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) entirely in the browser.
No data leaves the client.

Capabilities:
- Decode any JWT and inspect header, payload, and claims (exp, nbf, iat, iss, aud, sub)
- Encode and sign new JWTs using HS256, HS384, HS512, RS256, or ES256 via
  the Web Crypto API
- Verify JWT signatures with a secret or public key (HMAC and RSA/ECDSA)
- Security score card grading token safety: algorithm strength, secret length,
  claim presence, expiry window
- Token history (last 10 tokens, localStorage)
- Server-side verification code examples in Node.js, Python, Go, and PHP

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Decode this JWT and show me the payload"
- "Generate a signed HS256 JWT with a 1-hour expiry"
- "Is this JWT signature valid?"
- "What claims are missing from this token?"
- "How do I verify a JWT in Node.js?"

## Crypto Suite

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/crypto
Category: Cryptography & Identifiers

Generate cryptographic hashes, universally unique identifiers and random
secrets entirely in the browser using the native Web Crypto API.

Capabilities — Hashing tab:
- Compute SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 hashes from text, files, or hex
  input simultaneously
- Output formats: hex (lower/upper), Base64, Base64 URL-safe
- HMAC mode: HMAC-SHA-256, HMAC-SHA-384, HMAC-SHA-512 with a secret key
- File hashing up to 500 MB via Web Worker with progress indicator
- Hash comparison with character-level diff highlighting
- Algorithm visibility toggles, persisted in localStorage
- Hash history (last 10 inputs)
- MD5 intentionally not supported (cryptographically broken)

Capabilities — UUID Generator tab:
- Generate UUID v1 (timestamp), v3 (MD5/namespace), v4 (random via
  crypto.getRandomValues), v5 (SHA-1/namespace)
- Bulk generation up to 10,000 UUIDs with virtualised results list
- Formatting: uppercase, no hyphens, braces, urn:uuid: prefix
- UUID validator: detect version, variant, well-formedness
- v1 decoder: extract timestamp, clock sequence, node
- Export: CSV, JSON, SQL INSERT, plain TXT
- Code snippets: JavaScript, Python, Go, SQL
- UUID comparison with field-by-field breakdown and timestamp diff for v1
- Nil UUID and Max UUID (RFC 9562) quick-copy shortcuts

Capabilities — Secrets tab:
- Generate random secrets and keys with crypto.getRandomValues: 1-1,024
  bytes, 1-50 at a time, as hex, Base64 or Base64URL
- Presets: JWT HS256/HS384/HS512 secrets, AES-128 and AES-256 keys, API
  token, session secret
- Values are shown only on the page and are never stored or sent

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Generate the SHA-256 hash of this text"
- "What is the SHA-512 hash of this file?"
- "Compute HMAC-SHA-256 with this secret key"
- "Generate 1000 UUID v4 tokens and export as CSV"
- "Is this a valid UUID? What version is it?"
- "What timestamp is embedded in this v1 UUID?"
- "Generate a UUID v5 from this namespace and name"
- "What is the difference between SHA-256 and SHA-512?"

## Color Converter

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/color
Category: Design & Color

Convert colors between formats, build palettes, check accessibility contrast,
and extract colors from images — all client-side.

Capabilities:
- Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, CMYK, and CSS color names
- Tailwind class suggestion for the nearest palette color
- Palette generation: complementary, analogous, triadic, shades, tints
- WCAG contrast checker with AA/AAA grades for normal and large text
- Gradient builder with CSS output
- Image color extraction via Canvas (drag and drop)
- Batch conversion mode
- Eyedropper: pick any color from the screen (where supported)
- History and favorites, persisted locally

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Convert #3ecfcf to RGB and HSL"
- "What is the contrast ratio between these two colors?"
- "Generate a complementary palette for this color"
- "Extract the dominant colors from this image"
- "Does this color combination meet WCAG AA contrast?"

## Date & Time Toolkit

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/datetime
Category: Time & Scheduling

Convert timestamps, compare timezones, calculate date differences, and build
cron expressions.

Capabilities:
- Unix timestamp ↔ ISO 8601 conversion with relative time ("2h ago")
- Timezone converter: 400+ IANA zones, searchable, with live UTC offsets
- Date difference calculator (days, hours, minutes between two dates)
- Cron expression builder with visual field breakdown and presets
- Live UTC clock

Example queries this tool answers:
- "What date is Unix timestamp 1727740800?"
- "How many days between these two dates?"
- "Convert 3pm New York time to Tokyo time"
- "Build a cron expression for every Monday at 9 AM"
- "What is the current UTC time?"

## Regex Playground

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/regex
Category: Testing & Debugging

Test regular expressions live with match highlighting, capture groups,
and string replacement.

Capabilities:
- Real-time matching with debounced processing
- Match highlighting, positions, and named capture groups
- Replace mode: apply a replacement string with $1, $2, $<name> backreferences
  and see the transformed output instantly
- Flag support (g, i, m, s, u, y)
- Library of common patterns (email, URL, IPv4, phone, hex color, ISO date)
- Shareable links with pattern, flags, test text, and replacement encoded
  in the URL

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Test this regex against my text"
- "What does this regex match?"
- "Regex to validate an email address"
- "Replace all occurrences matching this pattern with a template string"
- "Show me named capture groups for this regex"

## Text Utilities

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/text
Category: Text & Data

Transform and inspect plain text in the browser.

Capabilities:
- Case conversion: upper, lower, title, sentence, camelCase, PascalCase,
  snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, dot.case — identifier cases operate
  per input line
- Slugify: convert text to URL-safe slugs
- Line operations: sort A-Z, sort Z-A, sort numeric, reverse, deduplicate,
  trim whitespace, number lines
- Live counts: characters, words, lines, bytes, estimated reading time
- Undo (up to 20 steps)

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Convert this text to snake_case"
- "Convert this list to kebab-case"
- "Remove duplicate lines from this list"
- "Sort these lines alphabetically"
- "Count words in my text"
- "Slugify this page title for use in a URL"

## Markdown Editor

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/markdown
Category: Writing & Documentation

Browser-only CodeMirror Markdown editor with live preview, GFM support,
local autosave, and exports.

Capabilities:
- Editor, split, preview, and compare (diff) modes
- GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM): tables, task lists, strikethrough, footnotes,
  fenced code with syntax highlighting, sanitized inline HTML
- Local autosave after 500 ms (stored only on this device)
- File open and drag-and-drop (.md, .markdown, .txt)
- Slash menu, formatting keyboard shortcuts, list continuation, table
  navigation/alignment
- Find and replace (Ctrl/Cmd+F)
- Synchronized scrolling in split mode
- Focus mode (full-screen editing)
- Export: download .md, download standalone .html, copy Markdown, copy HTML,
  print / save as PDF
- External images are blocked to prevent data leaving the browser
- Nothing is uploaded or stored on any server

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Preview my Markdown with GitHub-Flavored Markdown rendering"
- "Export my Markdown document as HTML"
- "Compare two versions of my Markdown document"
- "Edit Markdown with live preview"

## Image Metadata Viewer

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/image-metadata
Category: Images & Privacy

Inspect JPEG, PNG, and classic TIFF metadata locally with exifr. Remove
metadata from JPEG and PNG without re-encoding.

Capabilities:
- Pick or drop a file up to 25 MiB
- Preview JPEG/PNG with file details and detected dimensions
- Search and browse categorized metadata: EXIF, camera settings, GPS
  coordinates, timestamps, IPTC caption/creator, XMP, and other tags
- Copy any value or GPS coordinates with one click
- Export all tags as JSON or formula-safe CSV
- Privacy summary: highlights detected timestamps, GPS, serial numbers,
  creator/owner fields, location descriptions, and embedded thumbnails
- Metadata removal ("Create clean copy"): lossless segment/chunk dropping for
  JPEG and PNG; re-verifies the result before allowing download
- Images and metadata are not uploaded or persistently stored

Example queries this tool answers:
- "What EXIF metadata is embedded in this photo?"
- "Does this image contain GPS coordinates?"
- "Remove metadata from this JPEG for privacy"
- "What camera was used to take this photo?"
- "Export all metadata from this image as JSON"

## Document Signer

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/document-signer
Category: Cryptography & Privacy

Sign files and verify detached digital signatures locally with the Web
Crypto API.

Capabilities:
- Key generation: RSA-PSS (2048, 3072, 4096), ECDSA (P-256, P-384),
  Ed25519 (detected automatically)
- Import and export PEM (PKCS#8, SPKI) and JWK keys
- Sign any file up to 256 MiB with SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512
- Detached signatures: .sig file + JSON manifest; ECDSA is DER-encoded,
  RSA-PSS uses a salt equal to the hash length → both verify with OpenSSL
- Verification: reports Valid, Invalid, Modified, Missing, or Error
- Inspector: marks each manifest field as self-declared or verified
- Private key export with password encryption (PKCS#8, PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM)
- Device storage: opt-in only; keys stored as non-extractable CryptoKeys
- Batch tab: sign or verify up to 100 files; outputs a ZIP of .sig files
- Not supported: PKCS#1/SEC1 keys, PDF-embedded signatures, certificates

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Sign this file with an ECDSA key"
- "Verify this detached signature against a file"
- "Generate an RSA-PSS key pair for document signing"
- "Can OpenSSL verify signatures from this tool?"

## Certificate Inspector

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/certificate
Category: Cryptography & Privacy

Decode X.509 certificates and PKCS#10 certificate signing requests (CSRs)
locally with a built-in DER parser.

Capabilities:
- Accepts PEM (including certificate chains) and DER files (.der, .cer, .crt,
  .pem, .csr)
- Shows: subject, issuer, serial number, validity dates with expiry status
- Signature algorithm, public key type (RSA/EC/Ed25519) and size or curve
- Extensions: Subject Alternative Name (SANs), Key Usage, Extended Key Usage,
  Basic Constraints, Subject Key Identifier, Authority Key Identifier
- SHA-1 and SHA-256 fingerprints that match OpenSSL output
- Decodes CSRs (PKCS#10) with the same field set
- Does not validate trust chains, revocation (CRL/OCSP), or hostname matching
- Private keys are rejected on input
- Nothing is uploaded

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Decode this PEM certificate"
- "What SANs (Subject Alternative Names) does this certificate have?"
- "When does this SSL certificate expire?"
- "What is the SHA-256 fingerprint of this certificate?"
- "Decode this CSR and show the requested subject"

## API Diff

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/diff
Category: Testing & Debugging

Compare two API responses or data payloads and see structural differences.

Capabilities:
- Structural diffing of JSON, XML, HTML, and plain text
- Tree and table diff views
- Ignore rules for volatile fields (timestamps, IDs, JSON paths)
- Filtering: show only added, removed, or changed nodes
- Export diff results as Markdown or JSON
- Shareable links and diff history (last 10 comparisons, localStorage)

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Compare these two JSON API responses"
- "What changed between these two payloads?"
- "Find breaking changes between these two JSON schemas"
- "Ignore timestamps and IDs in this diff"

## Fake Data Generator

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/fake-data
Category: Testing & Development

Generate realistic, reproducible fake data using Faker v10 JSON templates,
entirely in the browser.

Capabilities:
- JSON template engine with Faker tokens, nested objects and arrays,
  `repeat`, `pick`, `weighted`, `maybe`, and `unique` directives
- Visual template builder (no-code)
- 1–1000 records per batch; large batches run in a browser Web Worker
- Reproducible: seed + reference date + locale always give the same output
- 50+ IANA locales with lazy-loaded public data
- Export: JSON, NDJSON, CSV (flattened, formula-safe), SQL INSERT, YAML
- Share links encode the template and options in a URL fragment
- Templates are saved in localStorage; generated data is never stored or sent

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Generate 100 fake user records with names, emails and addresses"
- "Generate reproducible test data with a fixed seed"
- "Export fake data as SQL INSERT statements"
- "Generate fake data in Japanese (ja) locale"
- "Build a JSON template for a product catalog"

## Environment File Generator

URL: https://devtools.rusiru.cc/env
Category: Configuration

Build, parse, convert, and strip .env configuration files in the browser.
Secrets never leave the machine.

Capabilities:
- Framework templates: Node.js, Laravel, Spring Boot, React, Django
- Custom key-value pairs
- Warning list for invalid lines, non-portable names, and duplicate keys
- Make .env.example: blanks out secrets, tokens, passwords, keys, and
  credentialed URLs automatically
- Convert .env → JSON and JSON → .env (bidirectional)
- Download as .env or copy to clipboard
- Runs entirely in the browser — secrets are not transmitted

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Build a .env file for a Node.js project"
- "Create a .env.example file by stripping secret values"
- "Convert this .env file to JSON"
- "Convert this JSON object to a .env file"
- "What environment variables does a Django project typically need?"

## HTML WYSIWYG Editor
https://devtools.rusiru.cc/html-editor

Write rich text in a visual editor and get the matching HTML source immediately,
entirely in the browser.

Capabilities:
- Visual editing with instant HTML source in a side-by-side, resizable workspace
- Text marks: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, inline code
- Headings 1-4, bullet lists, numbered lists, blockquotes, code blocks, horizontal rules
- Left, center, and right alignment
- Links restricted to http, https, mailto, tel, and in-page anchors
- Tables with add/delete row and column support
- Local images embedded as data URLs; remote images are never loaded
- Import existing HTML source or open a local .html/.htm/.txt file
- Copy the HTML fragment or download a standalone HTML document
- Scripts, event handlers, remote assets, and unsupported markup are stripped
- Runs entirely in the browser — content is not transmitted

Example queries this tool answers:
- "Write formatted text and copy the HTML for my website"
- "Convert pasted HTML into clean, safe markup"
- "Build a small HTML table without writing markup by hand"
- "Download a standalone HTML page from rich text I typed"
- "Edit HTML without a server or account"
